subject: Physics
central_question: How do sinusoidal voltages and currents behave in resistive, inductive and capacitive circuits, and how are resonance, power and transformers analysed?

known_pitfalls.claim: The useful AC rating is its full-cycle average.
known_pitfalls.correction: The full-cycle average is zero; ratings use rms value.

known_pitfalls.claim: An ideal inductor or capacitor consumes average power.
known_pitfalls.correction: Its voltage and current differ by 90°, giving zero average power.
Ideally current falls as voltage rises, conserving power.

recommended_example_progression: NCERT Exercise 7.1: resistor rms current and power
ncert_end_of_chapter_exercises_reference: The end-of-chapter EXERCISES begin at 7.1 and cover rms values, pure R/L/C circuits, resonance and power.
